name: GCP IAM Security Assessment
description: Security assessment of Google Cloud Platform Identity and Access Management. Covers IAM policies, roles (basic, predefined, custom), service accounts, workload identity federation, organization policies, and privilege escalation paths within GCP environments.

0.label: None
0.description: No exposure to GCP IAM security assessment

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands GCP IAM concepts including resource hierarchy, roles, and service accounts
evidence: Can explain GCP resource hierarchy (organization, folders, projects)
Understands IAM policy inheritance and role types
Familiar with service account impersonation and key management concepts

2.label: Guided Practice
2.description: Reviews GCP IAM configurations under supervision using established tools
evidence: Runs IAM enumeration tools (e.g., ScoutSuite, GCP-specific scanners) under guidance
Identifies overly permissive role bindings using lab checklists
Documents IAM findings with supervision; work reviewed by authorized personnel

3.label: Independent Practice
3.description: Independently assesses GCP IAM posture and identifies privilege escalation paths
evidence: Independently enumerates IAM policies across organization hierarchies
Identifies privilege escalation through service account impersonation and key abuse
Evaluates organization policy constraints and their effectiveness
Produces compliant GCP IAM assessment reports

4.label: Advanced / Mentor
4.description: Handles complex multi-project IAM assessments; discovers novel escalation techniques; mentors others
evidence: Assesses complex GCP organizations with nested folder structures and custom roles
Develops custom tooling for GCP IAM policy analysis and escalation detection
Reviews GCP IAM assessment work of junior analysts
Contributes to lab GCP IAM assessment methodology

5.label: Expert / Authority
5.description: Defines lab GCP IAM assessment methodology; publishes research on GCP IAM attack techniques
evidence: Designed or maintains the lab's GCP IAM assessment framework
Published research on novel GCP privilege escalation techniques
Trains teams on advanced GCP IAM security assessment
Recognized as authority on GCP IAM security

assessment_methods.description: Assess a deliberately misconfigured GCP organization and identify all privilege escalation paths through IAM
Review GCP IAM assessment findings from recent engagements for completeness and accuracy

cis: CIS Google Cloud Platform Foundation Benchmark v4.0.0 - Section 1 Identity and Access Management
